decision: Matt, 2026-10-20: "let's keep everything blind for now" - the pending sets stay out of every fit and are used only to score these frozen predictions

i2spec2026o.coefficients: parameter set i2spec2026o; hyperfine table default

hannover2008.coefficients: parameter set hannover2008; hyperfine table None

outcome_rule: values are read only by `score`, after this registry exists; no refit, no model or setting selection, no exclusion of targets after scoring. A data correction found later is reported beside, not instead of, these scores
exclusion: 127I2 P(13) 43-0: diagnostic target only, never in a headline score

partitions.blind: nothing of this measurement is in any training set
partitions.seen: an active set prints this measurement or a mean that contains it ([overlaps] same/mean)
partitions.superseded: an active set holds the same quantity re-measured or re-evaluated by the same authors ([overlaps] superseded)

kinds.intraline: component minus component of the same line (hyperfine only)
kinds.interline: component (or center) of one line minus that of another

metrics.residual: observed - predicted (MHz), observed at zero pressure and power
metrics.scores: per model, partition, kind and set: n, rms, median |r|, mean, rms of r/sigma, fraction within each threshold; paired on targets every compared model predicts

uncertainty_note: sigma is the measurement uncertainty alone; |r|/sigma describes disagreement with the measurement, not model confidence
